与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:利奥的经历、感受与成长。

The shopping mall looked quieter than usual that evening. Little by little, things began to change. People around Leo often share different ideas about the shopping mall. Curious, she peered through the keyhole at the party.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. The book store has become an important part of daily life. Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The geographer maps how the coastline changes each decade.

Leo wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Leo believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Best of all, the last exam question was really tricky.

Leo ordered salad and juice at the book store last night. Leo bought a pair of shoes online because it was much cheaper. At first, Leo found it difficult to keep the habit. Fair trade guarantees growers a minimum price.
Leo thanked Grace for the honest advice. The experience taught Leo more than any book could. Leo has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term.
